outcome: Higher admission to neonatal intensive care
finding: This descriptive review establishes a new, clinically relevant classification of umbilical cord anomalies based on pathological description and reported neonatal outcomes, advocating for mandatory placental cord insertion examination in the first and second trimesters.
mod_finding: Umbilical cord abnormalities can implicitly lead to an increased index of cesarean delivery due to the presence of fetal distress.
